XOne:shovel-knight.d: Shovel Knight is a 2014 platform game developed and published by Yacht Club Games. Players control the eponymous adventurer as he journeys to save his partner, Shield Knight, while fighting an evil Enchantress and a group of knights called the Order of No Quarter. Shovel Knight uses his shovel to attack, dig, and bounce on enemies as he progresses through levels that end with a boss fight. The player can collect treasure to improve Shovel Knight's abilities or purchase Relics which provide helpful effects.

Switch:dragon-quest-monsters-dark-prince.w: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince
Switch:dragon-quest-monsters-dark-prince.d: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince is a 2023 role-playing video game developed by Tose and published by Square Enix. It is the seventh game in the Dragon Quest Monsters series following Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker 3 and the first to be released outside of Japan since Joker 2 in 2011. The Dark Prince was released for the Nintendo Switch in December 2023 and for Android, iOS, and Windows in September 2024. The game received mixed reviews from critics and sold a million copies by January 2024.
